title: unified-rollouts-add-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Elena Park
description: Implements a unified rollout workflow that combines canary, A/B, and shadow traffic patterns with an automated multi-metric rollback engine. Motivation: make model rollouts safer and more observable while reducing manual intervention for rollbacks. This PR introduces a single orchestration flow that can express canary-only, A/B test, shadow-only, and mixed deployments, plus policy-driven auto-rollback based on configurable metric quorums and thresholds. Key features include: 1) rollout DSL extension to declare staged weights, shadow percentage, and probe policies; 2) a new autorollback engine that evaluates latency, error-rate, and model-quality metrics with quorum rules before triggering a rollback; 3) observability enhancements: rollout-level traces, per-variant telemetry, and aggregated rollback reasons; 4) stability guards: quorum backoff, grace windows, and manual quarantine stage; and 5) e2e test harness and load tests for regressions. Backwards compatibility: existing simple canary definitions continue to work, and rollout configs default to safe thresholds. The implementation includes unit, integration, and end-to-end tests as well as migration notes for rollout configs. See release_notes for important operational guidance.
